title: Harlem Hellfighters Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Harlem Hellfighters Congressional Gold Medal Act

This bill provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to the 369th Infantry Regiment, commonly known as the Harlem Hellfighters, in recognition of their bravery and outstanding service during World War I.

summary.headline: This law authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to honor the 369th Infantry Regiment, known as the Harlem Hellfighters, for their service in World War I.
summary.what_it_does: The law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to the 369th Infantry Regiment. The medal recognizes the unit's bravery and service during World War I. The official summary does not describe any other programs, payments, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted August 25, 2021. The summary does not state a separate effective date.
